results.question: What is CRP and why is it different from stuffing context?

crp.answer: CRP stands for Context-Relay Protocol, a context-relay protocol designed for agentic AI (Source: doc-1). It positions the right context for each Large Language Model (LLM) call instead of stuffing every possible context into the model (Source: doc-1). CRP v6 ships with three managed models under AutoCyberAI, including a SetFit intent classifier and a DeBERTa process-reward model (Source: doc-2). The Agent SDK (crp.Agent) allows developers to declare tools, policy, and models and runs the positioned loop with structured data (Source: doc-3).
